example.title: Nunes Dairy, Clay Tile Silo (HABS CA-2713-B)

brief: Hollow clay tile silo of 1916, about 16 ft across and 40 ft high: glazed buff-to-brown tile blocks laid in running bond with mottled color, no external hoops, a plain flat-topped rim with a thin coping band and no roof. Tall narrow vertical strip of door openings up one side. In the example it stands at the edge of a dirt livestock yard with board fences, low white-walled sheds and a big gable-roofed hay barn beyond.
